Because the two conditions interact, a navigator that handles mood screening and weight/nutrition guidance together can surface links a single-topic app would miss (for example low mood reducing activity, or weight stigma worsening mood) [1].

**Sources**
[1] Evidence on the bidirectional association between obesity and depression - Compiled summary of peer-reviewed literature (BJPsych Open meta-review; Frontiers in Psychiatry 2025; Obesity Reviews 2026) (2026-05-01). https://www.cambridge.org/c
